target.role: Senior Associate, Total Portfolio Rebalancing & Modelling

summary: Senior Associate, Total Portfolio Rebalancing & Modelling (12-month Contract) candidate with ~7 years of quantitative portfolio research across multi-asset institutional portfolios. Hands-on VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition, and near-optimal frontier analysis (Ortec GLASS) alongside Monte Carlo economic scenario-generator development; led the design of a Python-based multi-asset cash-flow projection engine at Moody's Analytics. Holds delegated sign-off on valuation and sensitivity outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement. Presents methodology and research findings to senior investment stakeholders. CFA; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Chemical Engineering).
core_skills: Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) · SQL · R · MATLAB

sections.heading: Multi-Asset Portfolio Modelling & Analytics
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio-level analytics delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream allocation and capital processes.
Oversaw duration and rate-sensitivity analysis under parallel and non-parallel yield-curve shocks across multi-asset institutional books.

sections.heading: Quantitative Model Development, Implementation & Testing
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across multi-year horizons.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Methodology Review & Research Communication
bullets: Contributes to methodology review, documentation, and benchmarking standards through Moody's model governance committee, supporting model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Escalates outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and acts as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering scenario impacts and portfolio sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated investment-team requirements into scoped development requests for Product Owners, contributing to the migration of all assigned accounts from the legacy Calypso platform.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning methodology requirements with system implementation and reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and implementation materials.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Advised institutional clients on Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and helped navigate Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) risk through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.

Led the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

Modelled actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables; performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
